packageRules.description: forensicnomicon is the shared knowledge layer; auto-open a bump PR in every fleet repo on a new release so the fleet never fragments across majors (0.3/0.4/0.5). In 0.x a minor bump is breaking (report model), so never automerge — review the grouped PR.
Group SecurityRonin fleet crates so a multi-crate bump (e.g. all three *-partition-forensic at once) lands as one reviewable PR.
